basic_details.short_information: KEA SDA FDA Recruitment 2026 has been announced by the Karnataka Examinations Authority for 5,431 vacancies across various Karnataka government departments, boards and corporations. The recruitment covers 2,726 degree-level and 2,705 PUC-level posts under the Residual Parent Cadre (RPC) and Kalyana Karnataka (KK) cadres. Interested candidates can submit online applications from 30 October to 25 November 2026 through the KEA website.

content_sections.heading: KEA SDA FDA Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Candidates should check the official KEA website for examination schedules, admission tickets and any revisions to the announced dates.

content_sections.heading: KEA SDA FDA Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: KEA has announced 5,431 vacancies through four separate recruitment notifications. These include 2,163 RPC FDA, 2,070 RPC SDA, 563 KK FDA and 635 KK SDA vacancies. The notifications cover various departmental posts with different educational qualifications and pay scales.

content_sections.heading: KEA SDA FDA Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for KEA SDA FDA Recruitment 2026 must possess the educational qualifications prescribed for the selected post. The requirements differ between PUC-level and degree-level recruitment, while certain specialised positions require specific academic disciplines or additional qualifications. Candidates must satisfy the educational requirements specified for their chosen post. Applicants for specialised posts must possess the relevant subject-specific qualification. Candidates applying under Kalyana Karnataka reservation provisions must meet the applicable regional eligibility and certificate requirements. Applicants must possess the required certificates and supporting documents as prescribed in the notification. Equivalent qualifications are accepted only when permitted under the relevant recruitment rules.

rows.educational_qualification: Second PUC or an equivalent qualification recognised under the applicable recruitment rules. Certain departmental posts may require specific subjects, including Commerce with Accountancy.

Graduation in the relevant discipline from a recognised university. Some posts require qualifications such as B.Com, BBA, BBM, engineering, computer-related degrees or other specified professional qualifications.

content_sections.heading: KEA SDA FDA Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The upper age limit for KEA SDA FDA Recruitment 2026 varies according to the candidate's reservation category. Additional relaxations may be applicable under the recruitment rules. Candidates should verify the minimum age, age-calculation date and applicable relaxation provisions in the relevant official notification. Additional concessions may apply to eligible candidates under the prescribed Karnataka recruitment rules.

content_sections.heading: KEA SDA FDA Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee varies according to the candidate's category and applicable recruitment provisions. The notifications specify the following fee amounts. Candidates must check the exact category-wise fee applicable to them in the official notification and application portal. The last date for fee payment is 26 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: KEA SDA FDA Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process for KEA SDA FDA Recruitment 2026 includes the prescribed competitive examinations and applicable Kannada language requirements. Final selection will be based on the relevant recruitment rules, examination performance and verification of eligibility. Kannada Language Test: Candidates required to qualify in Kannada must appear for the prescribed language examination. Competitive Written Examination: Applicants must attend the examinations applicable to their selected post and cadre. Merit List: Candidates will be considered according to examination performance, applicable reservation rules and other prescribed conditions. Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates must produce the required original certificates and supporting documents.

content_sections.heading: KEA SDA FDA Recruitment 2026 Exam Pattern
content_sections.text: The recruitment notifications prescribe two competitive examination papers, each carrying 100 marks. Candidates should refer to their applicable notification for the detailed syllabus and subject distribution. Negative Marking: The notifications prescribe a deduction of 0.25 marks for an incorrect answer in the applicable competitive examinations. The Kannada language test and its qualifying requirements should be checked separately in the relevant official notification.

content_sections.heading: KEA SDA FDA Recruitment 2026 Salary Details
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive salaries according to the pay scale notified for their respective posts. SDA and other PUC-level positions generally carry different pay scales from FDA and specialised degree-level positions. The exact pay scale depends on the department and position. Candidates should verify the salary details in the post-wise vacancy table of the applicable notification. The figures represent notified pay scales and should not be treated as guaranteed monthly in-hand salaries.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KEA SDA FDA Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply online through the Karnataka Examinations Authority recruitment portal until 25 November 2026. Applicants should complete the prescribed registration and fee-payment process within the announced deadlines. Visit the official KEA website at cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea/ . Open the relevant FDA, SDA or departmental recruitment notification. Select the appropriate RPC or Kalyana Karnataka recruitment category. Complete the online registration process using the required information. Enter personal, educational, reservation and post-preference details accurately. Upload the documents and certificates requested in the application form. Verify the application details before final submission. Pay the applicable application fee by 26 November 2026. Download or save the completed application and payment acknowledgement for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in KEA FDA SDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: KEA has announced 5,431 vacancies, including 2,163 RPC degree-level posts, 2,070 RPC PUC-level posts, 563 Kalyana Karnataka degree-level posts and 635 Kalyana Karnataka PUC-level posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for KEA FDA SDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 25 November 2026. The last date for fee payment is 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Can 12th Pass candidates apply for KEA SDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates with 2nd PUC / Class 12 or the prescribed equivalent qualification can apply for eligible PUC-level posts, subject to the post-wise requirements.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for KEA FDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: FDA and equivalent degree-level posts generally require a recognized Bachelor's degree. Certain positions also require specific subjects, professional qualifications or computer knowledge.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for KEA FDA SDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years. The maximum age is generally 40 years for General Merit, 43 years for Category 2A, 2B, 3A and 3B, and 45 years for SC, ST and Category-1 candidates, subject to the notified rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for KEA FDA SDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment notifications specify application fee amounts of Rs. 750, Rs. 500 and Rs. 250 depending on the applicable category and concession rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for KEA FDA SDA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection will be based on the prescribed competitive examination, followed by document verification and other applicable recruitment procedures.

faq.question: Q8. When will the KEA FDA SDA Examination 2027 be conducted?
faq.answer: The announced examination schedule includes 8, 9, 10, 16 and 17 January 2027. The applicable date depends on the recruitment category and examination paper.

faq.question: Q9. Are Kalyana Karnataka and RPC vacancies the same?
faq.answer: No. The Residual Parent Cadre and Kalyana Karnataka cadre have separate vacancy distributions and applicable reservation rules. Candidates should check their eligibility for the specific cadre.
